summary: Structural interdental sweeping. A highly textured, expanding floss that physically grabs and removes debris rather than slipping past it.
description: Toxin-free gap clearance. Traditional glide flosses use toxic Teflon (PTFE) that slides over plaque. This woven fiber expands upon contact with saliva, creating a multi-filament net that aggressively traps and extracts interdental biofilms.
technical_overview: Offered at $9.0 for 30m, this KoColor DENTAL_FLOSS is expertly formulated with Vegan Wax and Ultra-High-Molecular-Weight Polyethylene (UHMWPE). It delivers a high-fidelity Clean White color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages multi-filament saliva-expansion technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Wrap around middle fingers and gently saw between teeth, curving the floss into a 'C' shape around the base of each tooth.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Always floss before you brush. Dislodging the interdental plaque first allows your toothpaste's active ingredients to penetrate between the teeth.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: UHMWPE fibers possess a tensile strength 15 times greater than steel wire of the same thickness, ensuring zero shredding even in the tightest contacts.
